content: My friend shared this video on Facebook, and I’m sharing it here, simply because I want to maximize the effect of the message these wonderful designers – 24 Seven Designs, want to convey. It’s been a really long time since I have seen a video that inspires you to actually get up and do something about your usual wretched existence. So, watch it and enjoy it. :)
